clip.headline: Pirates Finish 12-2 and Ranked 16th, Then Hit a Rough Offseason Patch
clip.dek: East Carolina went 8-0 in the American but closed with back-to-back losses, and now four players have entered the portal.

posts.name: Purple Tide Pete
posts.text: 12-2. Ranked 16th. 8-0 in conference. At a 2.5 star program. Pirate_flag can lose to whoever he wants in January, I'm not mad. In the coach we TRUST 🏴‍☠️

posts.name: Linda Hargrove-Mills
posts.text: Season tickets since 1987 and I have NEVER seen a year like this. Yes the last two games hurt. Yes I yelled at my TV so loud the dog left the room. But 12 wins!! Let's not act like we didn't just have a magical season. Go Pirates, and Pirate_flag, take a bow. Also, can somebody tell me why a hot dog is $7 now?

posts.name: Dock Street Dave
posts.text: Made this for next season. Still not over 14-44 but we're so back anyway.

image.text: 12-2 AND I'M STILL HUNGRY. TRUST PIRATE_FLAG.

posts.name: PiratePride_NC
posts.thread: Memphis 44-14 then losing to Old Dominion... should we be worried or nah?
posts.text: Not panicking, just asking. We went from 42-6 over UTSA to getting boat-raced by Memphis, then dropped one 24-21 to Old Dominion. Two straight L's to end a 12-win year. Is the roster finally showing its limits with a team overall of 63? Or is this just a bad month?

posts.name: Bluff City Bobby
posts.text: 44-14. Thank you, East Carolina, for the content. Enjoy your 2.5 star ceiling, Pirates 🐯

posts.name: ECU Nation Daily
posts.text: Wishing Caden Knighten, Jeremiah Favorite, Grant Brake and the other guy who hit the portal nothing but the best. Thanks for the purple and gold. Pirate_flag has some depth chart rework to do but he's earned our patience.

posts.name: DepthChartDoctor
posts.thread: J.Smith was on Portal Watch and STAYED. What does this mean??
posts.text: J.Smith lands on Portal Watch because he's buried on the depth chart, the portal's open, and he just... stays. Either he loves it here or Pirate_flag has a plan nobody else sees. Either way it gives the backfield some breathing room. Speculate below. My money says the coach gets him on the field.

posts.name: Greenville Gina
posts.text: 12-2 season, so I don't mind paying. But $19 for a beer and a pretzel is criminal. Pirates, give us a loyalty discount for the 8-0 conference run.

posts.name: Recruiting Rumors East
posts.text: SOURCES: East Carolina's staff is working the portal hard after losing four. Class sits at No. 69 but my guy says the board is about to move. Nothing's confirmed, just vibes. Pirates fans, stay patient 👀

posts.name: Fire The Punter
posts.text: Ok but a 3-point bowl loss to ODU after Memphis? Someone needs to explain the play-calling to me. Not saying fire the OC, but I'm saying it with my eyes. Still love 12-2 though.

posts.name: Pirate Pete's Dad
posts.text: Still can't believe we dropped this one. 21-24 to Old Dominion in the bowl. One play. One stop. Next year hurts them instead.

posts.name: AnchorUpAnchorDown
posts.thread: Hot take: this season was a W. Fight me.
posts.text: Ranked 16th, 12-2, 8-0 in the conference, and half this board is crying like we went 2-10. The Memphis game was ugly and the bowl loss hurt, but we're a 2.5 star program that just had one of the best years in a long time. Take the win, enjoy the offseason, and trust the process.

clip.headline: Sixteen and Oh: Buckeyes Close the Book on a Perfect Season, Open the Portal Folder
clip.dek: Ohio State is the national champion at 16-0, but five departures to the portal give the offseason a little bite.

posts.name: Scarlet Sunday
posts.text: 16-0. National champs. Beat the No. 2 team 35-17 in the title game. I'm not even going to complain about the parking this time. Okay, I'll complain a little. Still, WE'RE SO BACK (we never left).

posts.name: Tuddy Truther
posts.text: Tuddy_roosevelt hasn't lost a game in 16 tries. Put him in the Hall of Fame. Put him on the money. Put him on the stadium. In the coach we trust.

posts.name: Nebraska Nick
posts.text: Enjoy it, Columbus. Title game 35-17 and I'm still replaying it. Respect to Tuddy_roosevelt, but we'll see you next year.

posts.name: Worried in Westerville
posts.text: Five guys in the portal and our recruiting class is ranked 138th. I know we just went 16-0, but you don't hang a banner and ignore the foundation. Somebody tell me it's fine.

posts.name: BYU Still Salty
posts.text: 28-26. Two points. That's the margin between a 15-1 Ohio State and the legend they're making now. Y'all know that, right? Sleep well.

posts.name: Dave Kowalczyk
posts.text: Season tickets since 1987. I've seen the Cooper years, the Tressel years, all of it. I have never seen a team go 16-0, win it all, and beat Indiana 41-17 in Week 15 like it was a scrimmage. Thank you, coach. My wife says I've watched the title game replay eleven times and I told her it's twelve. Go Bucks.

posts.name: Linda M. Hartwell
posts.text: Happy for the team, truly. But I read that we lost Tim Coffey, Jay Timmons and Dre Quinn to the portal. I hope the staff has a plan because these young men were part of the championship. Also, good news that K.Bing, R.Gado and the others decided to stay. Loyalty means something.

posts.name: Brutus Brewer
posts.text: Last frame of the season. Thank you for the ride 🌰🏆 35-17 over Nebraska for the natty. Still can't believe it.

posts.name: Katie in the Shoe
posts.text: Made this sign for the parade, my dad says it's the most Ohio sign he's ever seen.

image.text: 16-0 AND I'M STILL NERVOUS. THANKS TUDDY.

posts.name: Wallet Down Wes
posts.text: Celebration meal at the bowl watch party. Champions get to eat. My bank account is not a champion.

posts.name: BuckeyeGuru_Mike
posts.thread: PORTAL THREAD: Who's leaving, who's staying (Offseason 2028)
posts.text: Official tracker: LEFT: Tim Coffey (G), Jay Timmons (CB), Dre Quinn (EDGE), plus two more. STAYED: K.Bing, R.Gado, K.Greene, B.Lyle, N.Lautar, C.Gaydosh. A source close to the program says the K.Bing pay talk went fine. Staff is clearly keeping guys in the loop. I'm not worried. Mostly.

posts.name: OldSchoolOSU82
posts.text: I know we're 16-0 and 5-star prestige and 99 overall, but how is our class sitting at 138? Is the staff just coasting off the title? Tuddy_roosevelt is a wizard on the field, but even wizards need fresh bodies. Not panicking. Just asking.

posts.name: TrustTheTuddy
posts.thread: Re: Recruiting class ranked 138th?? Genuine question
posts.text: Brother, we went 16-0 and beat the No. 2 team for the title. The process works. Take a deep breath, have a beer, and hang the banner. If the class is a problem, the guy who just won every game will figure it out. In the coach we trust.

832438366.name: Penn State
factors: 5-7 falls short of what a 3.5-star program expects

clip.headline: Lions Limp Out at 5-7 as Ten Players Head for the Portal
clip.dek: A 3-6 Big Ten mark, two straight losses and a No. 137 recruiting class have Penn State fans demanding answers from agerm40.

posts.name: Beaver Canyon Brian
posts.text: 14-50 to Indiana. 13-45 to Iowa. 5-7. And we're supposed to clap because Pullard didn't transfer? Brother, the bar is on the floor and we're still tripping over it. FIRE. EVERYBODY.

posts.name: LionsDen_Lifer
posts.thread: OFFICIAL PORTAL EXODUS THREAD: 10 gone, including 3 four-stars
posts.text:
Mooney, Nsekhe, Slaughter and seven more. Ten guys looked at this program and said "nope." I'm not mad at them. I'm mad at whoever built a scheme that makes a 4-star WR want to sit in a portal. agerm40, explain yourself.

EDIT: yes I know Pullard, Zayas and Carver stayed. Congrats, we kept the guys who had nowhere better to go. Great news.

posts.name: Hawkeye Hank
posts.text: 13-45. Hope the Penn State fans enjoyed the view from the bottom of the Big Ten. We'll send a fruit basket to the 3-6 conference record. 🍎

posts.name: Kayla from Section EC
posts.text: Paid $85 to watch this. Left at halftime. The band was louder than the student section. Beautiful day for a funeral.

image.caption: Iowa game, 2nd quarter. Where did everybody go? Oh right, home.

posts.name: Donna M. Kowalczyk
posts.text: Season tickets since 1987. I was there for the good years, the bad years, and the years we didn't talk about. This is the first time I've felt NOTHING at a game. Not anger, nothing. We lost to Indiana 50-14 and I was thinking about parking. They're charging $40 to park for this?? Somebody at the athletic department needs to answer for this. Prayers for the Lions, and for my wallet.

posts.name: Tommy Two-Dogs
posts.text: $62 for this. We lost by 6 to UCLA and I'm paying more for a pretzel than the QB's completion percentage. Lost 25-31, my wallet lost bigger.

posts.name: RedZoneRick
posts.thread: Team is 94 overall and we lose 45-13 at home. Scheme or coach? (Don't say both)
posts.text:
94 overall. NINETY FOUR. That's not a 5-7 roster. That's a roster getting coached into the ground. Down 14-50 to Indiana, then 13-45 to Iowa, same flavor every time: no adjustments, no pressure, no plan. Either the OC is cooked or agerm40 is cooked. I say both.

Promote a ball boy. He can't be worse.

posts.name: Nittany Nate
posts.text: Recruiting class ranked 137th. ONE HUNDRED THIRTY SEVENTH. We're behind schools I've never heard of. Hire Saquon as head coach. Hire Saquon as recruiting coordinator. Hire Saquon as the punter. Just somebody. Anybody.

posts.name: Joe Pa's Ghost
posts.text: Rewatched the Indiana game for pain. This is what 14-50 looks like on a Saturday in Happy Valley. Not so happy. Who approved this.

posts.name: Rich Albrecht
posts.text:
Okay, everybody take a breath. We beat USC 30-21 on the road. J. Walker, a four-star edge, just signed. Pullard, Zayas and Carver all stayed. The portal hurt, no argument, but one bad year isn't the end of the world. The Big Ten is brutal. Give agerm40 one offseason to cook before we light the torches.

I'll wait for the comments calling me a clown. 🤡

posts.name: WalkerWatch
posts.thread: J. Walker signed for a reported $270K. Is the NIL math even working?
posts.text:
Love the pickup, Walker is a stud and I'm pumped for him in Blue and White. But $270K on one edge after losing ten guys to the portal? Where's the money for the rest of the roster? And the TV pitch worked. Cool. Maybe use that energy to win a game against a ranked team.

Not hating on the kid. Hating on the budget.

posts.name: Hoosier Hannah
posts.text: Penn State fans in the portal thread: "we're a 3.5-star program" lol. You gave up 50 to us at home and 45 to Iowa. Might want to check that star rating, it looks like a typo. 🔴⚪
